preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 500.
For each test case, the length of the array N must be between 1 and 1000.

postconditions.description: The output array must have a length equal to N.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 1000 for x in output)
postconditions.description: All elements in the output array must be positive integers in the range [1, 1000].

postconditions.expression: not any(all(output.count(x) % 2 == 0 for x in set(output)) for i in range(len(output)) for j in range(i+1, len(output)+1))
postconditions.description: There must not exist any subarray where all elements occur in even frequency.

postconditions.expression: max(output) == min(output) if N == 1 else max(output) > 1
postconditions.description: The maximum element in the output array must be minimized, and if N is 1, it must be the only element.
